name: reviewed-side-sun-with-local-fill
selection: Side sun retained after four native trials. Reduce the focused 650 W trial's right fill and ambient/left fill slightly; validate in full-resolution front and oblique renders.
assumptions: Sun direction and powers are inferred appearance calibration, not measured lighting from the production scene.
Camera and glossy sky appearance are separated from diffuse world illumination as an explicit artistic approximation.
The browser retains its existing sky-color calibration until it can be visually checked; browser light direction and fill powers are synchronized.
